ACCESSIBILITY STATEMENT

Built to be usable.
Clear about the details.

Accessibility is part of how Biro.dev works, including on this website. This statement explains our target, what we have checked, what we have not yet verified, and how to tell us when something gets in your way.

OUR TARGET

WCAG 2.2 Level AA.

The Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2 at Level AA are our design target for this website. This is a goal we work toward, not a certification. The site has not been independently audited, and we do not claim full conformance.

01

Keyboard first

Every page has a skip link, visible focus outlines, and a menu you can open, close with Escape, and navigate without a mouse.

02

Readable and flexible

Text and background colors are chosen for strong contrast. Layouts reflow to narrow screens without sideways scrolling, and motion is reduced when your system asks for it.

03

A demo that waits for you

The AddvancedFocus concept never starts a timer on its own. You can pause, stop without marking anything complete, or undo a completion, and status changes are designed to be announced by screen readers.

WHERE THINGS STAND

What we’ve checked so far.

Reviewed October 9, 2026

Checks completed

  • Every page at 320 and 375 pixel widths, with no horizontal scrolling
  • One main heading per page, no skipped heading levels, and labeled landmarks
  • Text alternatives for informative images
  • Calculated text contrast against Level AA thresholds on every page
  • Keyboard operation of the menu and the AddvancedFocus demo, including focus placement and announcements

Performed in Chromium and WebKit using automated (axe) and keyboard checks.

Not yet verified

Still to test

  • Screen readers, including VoiceOver, NVDA, and TalkBack
  • Additional browsers and physical mobile devices
  • Voice control and switch access
  • An independent accessibility audit

Until these are complete, some barriers may remain.

Known limitations

What to be aware of

  • Product mockups and the logo collection are images. The workflow each one illustrates is also described in the page text.
  • Contact links open your own email app. The website has no form of its own.

These describe this website, not the future applications.

Something not
working for you?

Please tell us. Accessibility feedback directly shapes what we fix next.

It helps to include the page address, what you were trying to do, and what happened. If you are comfortable sharing it, mention your browser, device, and any assistive technology you use. You do not need to share a diagnosis or other personal health information.

Send accessibility feedback

A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

About this statement.

Does this statement cover Biro.dev’s future apps?

No. It covers this website, including the AddvancedFocus concept demo. Each future application is still in development, and its accessibility approach will be described before public release.

Will this statement change?

Yes. We will update it as testing expands and as we fix issues. The review date above shows when it was last checked.
